description: Connect your Dorqa account and ask about your websites in plain language. Check whether any website can be found and quoted by Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT, without adding a project. List your projects, get the Dorqa Brief for a site, find internal links worth adding, and see the questions people ask about a topic. Access is read-only. Dorqa never changes your site, and these tools use no Dorqa credits. You need a Dorqa account. Sign in once to connect, and disconnect any time from AI assistants in your Dorqa account menu.
